Title: Azure Container Registry is now generally available in South Africa North

Body.Content:
Azure Container Registry is now generally available in South Africa North. See where Azure Container Registry is available and where it's coming next in the list of Azure products available by region.

Azure Container Registry offers geo-replication, which enables an Azure container registry to function as a single registry, serving multiple regions with multi-master regional registries. Placing a container registry in each region where images are run allows network-close operations, enabling fast, reliable image layer transfers.

Learn more by reviewing the documentation.
